Chair sets the written deadline for amendments to draft article 9 (social security, final ICESCR 9). Procedural, but about that one article.

sonnet.reason: Chair announces no time limit for amendments and asks delegations to submit them by 5 p.m.; pure order of work.

Chair summarizes procedural motions under the rules of procedure and calls the vote on Mexico's closure motion; no article content.

Chair reports adoption of paragraph 1 of draft article 14, the ex post facto article per Wilson's speech; final ICCPR 15.
Chair proposes the order of work for the whole draft Declaration (accept uncommented articles, start with article 4).

Procedural vote on the order of work: hear the Drafting Group's article 8 report before starting article 9; no article's content.

Chair on minority observations going in an annex to the report, and the deadline for them; procedural.
Chair notes general agreement on his proposed procedure; order of work only.

sonnet.reason: Chair moves on to article 9 because article 8's French text is missing: order of work, tied to two articles, none dominating.
